case.title: Operation Golden Kuber - Illegal Instant Loan App Extortion Syndicate
case.description: Cross-border predatory lending apps operating through forged NBFC gateway accounts in Pune and Bengaluru, harassing borrowers in vernacular languages with rapid fund draining.
